name: agentprov-zenodo
summary: AgentPROV's draft-only Zenodo uploader (D-790, D-870, D-880): unpublished drafts, communities, reserved DOIs and cross-links from deposit drafts made by `agentprov package --deposit`. Never publishes. Standard library for the network; outside the agentprov package (HL H.10.1(1)).
author: Nicholas Jones
